response.sql: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) as member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), total_members AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) as total FROM group_counts), group_shares AS (SELECT gc.link_to_major, gc.member_count, CAST(gc.member_count AS REAL) / tm.total as share FROM group_counts gc CROSS JOIN total_members tm), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM group_shares), filtered_groups AS (SELECT gs.member_count, gs.share, avg.avg_share FROM group_shares gs CROSS JOIN average_share avg WHERE gs.share > avg.avg_share) SELECT SUM(member_count) as total_members, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) as average_excess FROM filtered_groups
